description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Partner Colorado Credit Union is seeking a Software Engineer to support its growing company and financial client applications. The role involves recommending, designing, coding, testing, and enhancing software solutions and database structures while collaborating with the CIO, technical team, and end users.
Software developer building and enhancing financial applications, databases, and supporting software solutions

Responsibilities:
• Working under the supervision of the CIO and collaborating with a technical team and end users, the software developer will have the opportunity to recommend and build software solutions, to design, code, test and enhance programs and database structures to support financial client applications

Requirements:
• We are seeking an individual with a strong ability to analyze/design and implement software solutions
• Proficiency in the development of software
• Proficiency and/or willing to train in Power On, Episys/Symitar (proprietary)
• Basic knowledge of scripting
• API integration knowledge
• Experience with JavaScript
• Excel in working in an Agile Development environment
• Basic network understanding of LAN/WAN applications, libraries, folders, users, passwords, and files
• Displays a proactive approach to system security and compliance
• Demonstrates proactive approach with a quality mindset and attention to detail
• Displays excellent organizational and planning skills
• Shows up-to-date knowledge of technological advancements
• Data model design and object configuration and relationship mapping
• Knowledge of database concepts (tables, fields, relationships)
• Ability to work in high-pressure situations, meet deadlines, prioritize tasks and goals
• Ability to adjust to a constantly changing industry
• Ability to maintain good organization skills
• Displays professionalism through all aspects
• Displays a high regard towards teamwork
• Displays effective, clear communication
• Displays self-confidence and self-motivation
• Bachelor's degree in related field or equivalent training/experience
• One year of computer programming experience and/or training

Preferred:
• Knowledge of Synergy, Symconnect, SymExchange a plus
• Knowledge of SQL, HTML, XML, ASP, C++, CSS, C# a plus
